name: repo-guardian
description: Repository health checks and local rule enforcement: CI presence, .gitattributes, README language, forbidden commands, emoji and temp-file placement, plus comment-rule lint after every write.

description_i18n.en: Repository health checks and local rule enforcement: CI presence, .gitattributes, README language, forbidden commands, emoji and temp-file placement, plus comment-rule lint after every write.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 仓库健康检查与本机规则执行：CI 有无、.gitattributes、README 语言、禁用命令、emoji 与临时文件落点，以及写入后的注释规范核对。
